contacts.label: Research Limitations
contacts.value: Unable to verify current official Transnistria government contacts. Web search budget exhausted (200/200 calls). Direct website access to known government domains (mfa.dmr.md, dmr.md) failed with DNS and SSL errors. Transnistria is a de facto independent state not internationally recognized by most countries, which limits publicly available verified contact information.
